name: hy3d_storage_box_closed_r160
description: Same product, second generation: Hunyuan3D-2 (Hugging Face Space, shape only, seed 4321) from a FLUX.1-schnell reference photo with the lid CLOSED (samples/hy3d/box_closed_ref_ai.png). Chosen to test the opposite workflow: model closed, articulate, validate opening.
dimension_basis: prompt asked for 40 x 30 x 27 cm; width is the scale basis. The generator made the footprint square (depth 0.40 at width 0.40) and the height 0.28, so depth and height here are measured, not requested.
density_basis: polypropylene, assumed uniform; walls are thin shells, filled holes may over-estimate mass

split.basis: measured: the footprint jumps from 0.373 m (body) to 0.400 m (lid overhang) at z = 0.223 m; cut just below the overhang

joints.name: lid_hinge
joints.basis: hinge along the lid's lower back edge (y = +0.198 at the seam z = 0.222). 0 = closed as modelled; negative = opening (right-hand rule about +X); -110 = fully open
